desc:
🚗 Build roads, connect cities & grow a giant traffic empire across the WORLD!

🆕 UPDATE 3: EUROPE IS HERE!
• Europe & Greenland: 41 new countries, 254 states & 664 cities
• World menu: unlock Europe with keys & pick a FREE starting country
• ADMIN ABUSE events: x3 rainbow cars, Gem Rain & up to x5 Money/XP
• Auto Upgrade: your cities upgrade themselves
• Workshop: new Ruby (+200%) & Galaxy (+400%) cars

🛣️ HOW TO PLAY
• Drag roads between cities: every arriving car earns money & XP
• Buy states & unlock whole countries with keys
• Upgrade towns to metropolises & boost your cars

⭐ FEATURES
• 644 states in 60+ countries, from Alaska to Argentina to Europe
• 7 city themes that transform the map: Modern, Western, Blossom, VIP & more
• Auto Build, co-op, gifts, daily rewards, offline income & leaderboards
• +10% XP per friend in your server, +10% money with ROBLOX PLUS!

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite for updates!
👥 Join the WE Interactive group for 15 min of 2x XP daily!
